tool.name: SNAF T-antigen prediction
tool.description: predict splicing-derived peptides with HLA binding and immunogenicity scores
tool.command: python3 -m altanalyze3.components.neoantigen unpack --archive '$reference' --outdir reference && SNAF_OFFLINE=1 altanalyze3 snaf --juncounts '$counts' --hla '$hla' --db_dir reference --genome_fasta '$genome' --cpus \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --output snaf --export_proteomics --binding_method MHCflurry

has_text.text: Reference archive must contain Alt91_db and controls

tool.help: Runs SNAF with MHCflurry and DeepImmuno. Administrators must provision the pinned model bundle described in the deployment README. Uses supplied HLA types; bam2hla is available as a separate tool. The small bundled test exercises missing-reference rejection. A full prediction acceptance test requires the scientific reference and models.
